description_en: Suspends or starts a cloud honeypot instance
description_zh: 暂停或开启云蜜罐实例
name: ModifyVpcHoneyPot

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID of the cloud honeypot instance to take effect.

You can call the [DescribeVpcHoneyPotList](~~DescribeVpcHoneyPotList~~) operation to obtain the VPC ID
parameters.help_zh:
要生效的云蜜罐实例的VPC ID。

您可以调用[DescribeVpcHoneyPotList](~~DescribeVpcHoneyPotList~~)接口获取VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the action to perform on the cloud honeypot instance. Valid values:

disable: Suspends the instance.
enable: Starts the instance
parameters.help_zh:
指定暂停或开启云蜜罐实例。取值：

disable：暂停
enable：开启
parameters.name: honey_pot_action

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
